def test_parse_music():
    # Canonical example: whole, half, and quarter notes
    assert parse_music('o o| .| o| o| .| .| .| .| o o') == [4, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 4, 4]

    # Empty string returns empty list
    assert parse_music('') == []

    # String with only spaces returns empty list
    assert parse_music('   ') == []

    # Single whole note
    assert parse_music('o') == [4]

    # Single half note
    assert parse_music('o|') == [2]

    # Single quarter note
    assert parse_music('.|') == [1]

    # Repeated same notes
    assert parse_music('o o o') == [4, 4, 4]
    assert parse_music('o| o|') == [2, 2]
    assert parse_music('.| .| .|') == [1, 1, 1]

    # Mixed notes in various orders
    assert parse_music('.| o| o') == [1, 2, 4]
    assert parse_music('o .| o| .|') == [4, 1, 2, 1]

    # Leading/trailing spaces are ignored (empty tokens filtered)
    assert parse_music(' o o| ') == [4, 2]

    print("All tests passed!")
